title: Curves are quasi-projective
statement:
Every smooth separated curve over a field
$k$ is quasi-projective: there
is a locally closed immersion $C\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^N_k$.

proof.text: Use Scheme.dim_eq_topologicalKrullDim [lem-pc-scheme-dimension-local-rings] and IsCurve.krullDim_le_one to obtain U.dim <= 1. The IsCurve instance already supplies separatedness, locally finite type, and quasi-compactness.

Apply exists_closed_open_immersion_projectiveSpace_of_dim_le_one [lem-sc-dim-one-quasi-projective] to p. Obtain a closed immersion i:U -> V and an open immersion j:V -> projective space, with i composed with the structure map g equal to p and j composed with the projective-space structure map equal to g.

The composite i followed by j is an immersion by the Mathlib composition instance. Choose the finite coordinate type ULift(Fin(N+1)); associativity and the two supplied commutativities show that this immersion is over the field, which is exactly IsQuasiProjective p.
